name: zovo-shell-formatter
description: Shell formatter for VS Code: format bash, sh, zsh, bats and mksh scripts with shfmt built in as WebAssembly, so there is nothing to install. Reads .editorconfig, shows syntax errors in Problems, skips .env files and checks that formatting keeps the same commands. Free and offline.

enumDescriptions: From the first line (#!/bin/bash, #!/bin/sh, ...), then the file name (.bash, .zsh, .bats, .ksh). Bash when neither says.
Z shell. shfmt's zsh support is new; files it cannot parse are left unchanged.
shellFormatter.dialect.description: Shell dialect for parsing. Same as shfmt -ln. A shell_variant key in .editorconfig wins over this setting.

shellFormatter.indent.markdownDescription: Indent. Empty (`null`) follows the editor: tabs, or spaces with the editor's tab size. `0` is tabs, a number above 0 is that many spaces (shfmt -i). `indent_style` and `indent_size` in .editorconfig win over this setting.

shellFormatter.binaryNextLine.description: Binary operators like && and | may start a line (shfmt -bn, EditorConfig binary_next_line).

shellFormatter.switchCaseIndent.description: Indent the patterns inside case ... esac (shfmt -ci, EditorConfig switch_case_indent).

shellFormatter.spaceRedirects.description: Put a space after redirect operators: > file (shfmt -sr, EditorConfig space_redirects).

shellFormatter.keepPadding.description: Keep column alignment padding (shfmt -kp, EditorConfig keep_padding).

shellFormatter.functionNextLine.description: Put the opening brace of a function on the next line (shfmt -fn, EditorConfig function_next_line).

shellFormatter.simplify.description: Simplify the code, for example $(( $a + 1 )) to $((a + 1)) (shfmt -s). This changes code on purpose, so the same-commands check is off when it is on.

shellFormatter.minify.description: Minify the script: remove comments and spacing (shfmt -mn). Rarely wanted in an editor.

shellFormatter.useEditorConfig.description: Read the shfmt keys from .editorconfig files (indent_style, indent_size, shell_variant, binary_next_line, switch_case_indent, space_redirects, keep_padding, function_next_line, simplify, minify, ignore), the same way shfmt does.

shellFormatter.verifyCommands.description: Before a change is applied, parse the formatted script again and check that it runs the same commands as the original. If not, the file is left unchanged. Files over 256 KB skip this check.

shellFormatter.skipFiles.description: File names that are never formatted, even when they are open as shell scripts. * and ? are wildcards.

shellFormatter.maxFileMB.description: Files larger than this are not formatted, and a message says so.

shellFormatter.timeoutSeconds.description: Stop formatting after this many seconds and leave the file unchanged. The editor never waits on it.

shellFormatter.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating at the earliest after scripts were formatted without an error on two occasions at least 30 minutes apart. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

shellFormatter.showSupportLinks.description: Show the Rate, More free viewers and Sponsor links in the status bar tooltip. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.description: Format bash, sh, zsh and bats scripts with shfmt. Nothing to install.

steps.title: Format a script
steps.description:
Open a .sh file and press Shift+Alt+F (Shift+Option+F on macOS). If VS Code asks which formatter to use, pick Shell Formatter.
[Open the sample script](command:shellFormatter.openSample)
[Use as default formatter](command:shellFormatter.setDefault)

media.altText: A bash script formatted by Shell Formatter in VS Code, with the shfmt status bar item.

steps.title: Format on save
steps.description:
Turn on Format On Save to format each time you save.
[Turn it on for shell scripts](command:shellFormatter.formatOnSave)

steps.title: Syntax errors
steps.description: When shfmt cannot parse a script, the file stays unchanged and the Problems panel shows the line and column.

media.altText: An unclosed here-document shown in the Problems panel by Shell Formatter.

steps.title: Options and .editorconfig
steps.description:
Pick the indent, case indent and other shfmt options, or put them in .editorconfig so the whole team and CI get the same result.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22shellFormatter%22%5D)
